description: A clock generator with six dividers and multipliers, able to send and follow tempo as a control voltage as well as pulses

params.text: Sets how much of each main clock pulse is high, 0% to 100%
Restarts the clock from the first beat of the bar
Divides or multiplies the main clock for that row, from a 256th of it to 256 times it, with x1 in the centre
Sets how much of that row's pulse is high, 0% to 100%, or the swing amount when 'Trig/Swing on Div' is ticked for that row

inputs.text: An external clock to follow instead of the BPM knob, counted off against the PPQN resolution set on the menu, or a tempo voltage with 'CV clock IN' ticked
A trigger here restarts the clock from the first beat of the bar
A trigger here starts or stops the clock, as the RUN button does

outputs.text: The main clock, at the tempo and pulse width set, or a tempo voltage with 'CV clock OUT' ticked
A pulse when a reset happens, and on run or stop where 'Pulse to RST out' is ticked
That row's divided or multiplied clock

notes: the BPM display is coloured by where the tempo comes from: yellow for the BPM knob, blue for external pulses and green for an external tempo voltage.
the algorithm varies the length of individual clock pulses so that the number of beats in a minute comes out exact, so the pulses are not all the same length.
there is no metronome, time signature or audio click on this version, and no BEAT or BAR output.
menu: CV clock IN — makes the EXT jack read a tempo voltage rather than clock pulses; it is also on the EXT jack's own right-click menu
CV clock OUT — makes the CLK jack send a tempo voltage rather than clock pulses; it is also on the CLK jack's own right-click menu
Trig/Swing on Div #1 — makes that row send a 1ms trigger instead of a gate, and turns its PW knob into a swing control that delays the even pulses of a multiplication
Trig/Swing on Div #2 — makes that row send a 1ms trigger instead of a gate, and turns its PW knob into a swing control that delays the even pulses of a multiplication
Trig/Swing on Div #3 — makes that row send a 1ms trigger instead of a gate, and turns its PW knob into a swing control that delays the even pulses of a multiplication
Trig/Swing on Div #4 — makes that row send a 1ms trigger instead of a gate, and turns its PW knob into a swing control that delays the even pulses of a multiplication
Trig/Swing on Div #5 — makes that row send a 1ms trigger instead of a gate, and turns its PW knob into a swing control that delays the even pulses of a multiplication
Trig/Swing on Div #6 — makes that row send a 1ms trigger instead of a gate, and turns its PW knob into a swing control that delays the even pulses of a multiplication
Resolution — under the 'External Clock' heading, sets how many pulses per quarter note the EXT jack is sending: 1, 2, 4, 8, 12, 16 or 24
Reset Bar — under the 'On Run' and 'On Stop' headings, restarts the clock from the first beat of the bar at that moment
Pulse to RST out — under the 'On Run' and 'On Stop' headings, sends a pulse from the RST output at that moment
DIV/MULT mouse controls — with it ticked a click or right-click on a div/mult display steps that knob; unticking it gives the display the ordinary knob menu instead
